title: FastRegistry: L1 Cache API layer (RED)
description:
RED phase: Implement L1 Cache API layer with SWR

## Architecture
L1 Cache API (FREE, ~1-5ms) → L2 Index DO (~2-3ms) → L3 newUniqueId (~56ms)

## L1 Cache Implementation
- Use Cloudflare Cache API (FREE unlimited reads)
- SWR pattern: serve stale, revalidate in background
- Cache key: `{prefix}/fast/{namespace}/{name}`

## Functions to implement
```typescript
// Cache helpers
function buildCacheKey(prefix: string, namespace: string, name: string): string
function isCacheStale(response: Response): boolean
async function cacheEntry(entry: FastRegistryEntry): Promise<void>
async function lookupFromCache(namespace: string, name: string): Promise<FastRegistryEntry | null>
```

## Test cases
- Cache hit returns entry immediately
- Cache miss returns null
- Stale cache triggers background revalidation
- Cache key format is correct
- TTL headers are set correctly
close_reason: Implemented L1 Cache API layer with SWR pattern: getCache, buildCacheKey, isCacheStale, cacheEntry, lookupFromCache, invalidateFastRegistryCache

title: FastRegistry: Core types and interfaces (RED)
description:
RED phase: Define core types for FastRegistry

## Key Insight
- idFromName() costs ~157ms (global coordination)
- idFromString() costs ~5ms (no coordination)
- FastRegistry stores hex IDs and uses idFromString() for 31x speedup

## Types to define in src/fast-registry.ts

```typescript
interface FastRegistryEntry {
  name: string           // Logical name
  hexId: string          // DO ID from id.toString()
  namespace: string      // DO class name
  locationHint: string   // Region (enam, weur, apac)
  createdAt: number
  lastAccessedAt: number
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}

interface FastRegistryConfig {
  cacheTtlSeconds?: number      // Default: 30
  staleTtlSeconds?: number      // Default: 300  
  cacheKeyPrefix?: string
  trackAccessTime?: boolean
}

interface FastRegistryStats {
  l1CacheHits: number
  l2IndexHits: number
  l3CreationFallbacks: number
  registrations: number
  hitRate: number
}
```

## Test file: src/__tests__/fast-registry.test.ts
RED tests for type exports and interface shapes
